mapper.sql: r.payment_status in (2, 4) and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = r.owner_id and t.del_flag = 0 and t.club_id = #{clubId})) or (r.owner_type = 2 and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = r.owner_id and a.del_flag = 0 and a.club_id = #{clubId})) )

r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), concat('成员#', r.member_id)) as display_name, max(u.avatar) as avatar, max(u.phone) as phone, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as verified_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as refunded_count, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, r.total_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paid_amount, max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) as last_interaction_time
mapper.select:
select agg.*, ( select coalesce(t2.name, a2.name) from cms_registration r2 left join cms_topic t2 on t2.id = r2.owner_id and r2.owner_type = 1 left join cms_activity a2 on a2.id = r2.owner_id and r2.owner_type = 2 where r2.member_id = agg.member_id and r2.payment_status = 2 and ( (r2.owner_type = 1 and t2.club_id = #{clubId} and t2.del_flag = 0) or (r2.owner_type = 2 and a2.club_id = #{clubId} and a2.del_flag = 0)) order by r2.create_time desc limit 1 ) as last_topic_name from ( select from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 left join club_customer_profile p on p.club_id = #{clubId} and p.member_id = r.member_id where
and coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and (p.remark is not null and p.remark <> '')
group by r.member_id
having sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 2
having sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) <= 1
order by last_interaction_time desc limit #{limit} ) agg
select count(distinct r.member_id) from cms_registration r where
select count(*) from ( select r.member_id, min(r.create_time) as first_time from cms_registration r where group by r.member_id having first_time >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') ) firsts
select from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 where r.member_id = #{memberId} and group by r.member_id

select concat('reg-', r.id) as record_key, case when r.owner_type = 1 then r.owner_id else a.topic_id end as topic_id, coalesce(t.name, a.name) as title, date_format(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as occurred_at, case when r.payment_status = 4 then 'REFUNDED' when r.verification_status = 1 then 'VERIFIED' else 'PENDING' end as status_code from cms_registration r left join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 1 left join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 where r.member_id = #{memberId} and order by coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time) desc limit #{limit}

select r.id as registration_id, r.real_name as participant_name, r.registration_status as registration_status, r.point_used as point_used, r.payable_amount as payable_amount, r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), concat('成员#', r.member_id)) as display_name, u.avatar as avatar, u.phone as phone, r.parent_order_no as order_no, r.payment_status as payment_status, r.verification_status as verification_status, r.verification_time as verification_time, coalesce(a.start_date, t.start_date) as session_time, coalesce(a.id, 0) as session_id,
(select min(mr.create_time) from merchant_review mr where mr.registration_id = r.id and mr.status = 'VISIBLE') as review_time from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 left join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 1 left join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 where r.payment_status in (2, 4) and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and t.id = #{topicId} and t.club_id = #{clubId} and t.del_flag = 0) or (r.owner_type = 2 and a.topic_id = #{topicId} and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0) ) order by session_time asc, r.create_time asc

select t.member_id as ownerMemberId, (select count(*) from cms_topic_node n where n.topic_id = t.id and n.status = 1) as nodeCount, coalesce(sum(case when r.id is null then 0 else ifnull(r.order_num, 1) end), 0) as sessionHeadcount, coalesce(sum(case when r.id is null then 0 when r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingVerifyCount, coalesce(sum(case when r.verification_status = 1 and r.verifier_id = #{viewerId} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as verifiedByMeCount,
(select case when a.cancel_time is not null then 'CANCELLED' when gs.status is not null then gs.status when a.end_date <= now() then 'FINISHED' when a.start_date <= now() then 'RUNNING' else 'NOT_PREPARED' end from cms_activity a left join game_session gs on gs.activity_id = a.id where a.topic_id = t.id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0
and a.id = #{activityId} and 1 = (select count(*) from cms_activity a2 where a2.topic_id = t.id and a2.club_id = #{clubId} and a2.del_flag = 0) ) as sessionStatus from cms_topic t left join cms_registration r on r.payment_status = 2 and (
(r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and exists (select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = #{activityId} and a.topic_id = t.id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0)) or (r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = t.id and exists (select 1 from coop_group_member_verify g where g.registration_id = r.id and g.activity_id = #{activityId})
and exists (select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = #{activityId} and a.topic_id = t.id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0))
(r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = t.id and t.club_id = #{clubId}) or (r.owner_type = 2 and exists (select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = r.owner_id and a.topic_id = t.id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0))
)
where t.id = #{topicId} and t.del_flag = 0 and (t.club_id = #{clubId} or exists (select 1 from coop_order o where o.topic_id = t.id and o.to_type = 'club' and o.to_id = #{clubId} and o.status = 0 and o.del_flag = 0 and not exists (select 1 from coop_invite legacy_invite where legacy_invite.id = o.invite_id and legacy_invite.invite_type = 2))) group by t.id
mapper.insert: insert into club_customer_profile (club_id, member_id, tags_json, remark, updated_by, request_id) values (#{clubId}, #{memberId}, #{tagsJson}, #{remark}, #{updatedBy}, #{requestId}) on duplicate key update tags_json = values(tags_json), remark = values(remark), updated_by = values(updated_by), request_id = values(request_id)
mapper.select:
select r.id as registration_id, r.real_name as participant_name, r.registration_status as registration_status, r.point_used as point_used, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), concat('成员#', r.member_id)) as display_name, u.avatar as avatar, u.phone as phone, r.parent_order_no as order_no, r.ticket_name as ticket_name, r.order_num as order_num, r.payable_amount as payable_amount, r.payment_time as payment_time, r.payment_status as payment_status, r.verification_status as verification_status, r.verification_time as verification_time, coalesce(a.start_date, t.start_date) as session_time,
(select min(mr.create_time) from merchant_review mr where mr.registration_id = r.id and mr.status = 'VISIBLE') as review_time, coalesce(t.name, a.name) as topic_name, coalesce(t.img_url, a.img_url) as topic_cover, nullif(vu.nickname, '') as operator_name, nullif(vm.name, '') as store_name from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 left join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 1 left join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and r.owner_type = 2 left join ums_member vu on vu.id = r.verifier_id and vu.del_flag = 0 left join mms_merchant vm on vm.member_id = r.verifier_id and vm.del_flag = 0 where r.id = #{registrationId} and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and t.id is not null and t.club_id = #{clubId} and t.del_flag = 0) or (r.owner_type = 2 and a.id is not null and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0) ) limit 1
